reason: Alert-TP: The resolved sink value at line 35 depends on attacker-controlled input from request.getParameter(). While param.replace("\"", """) escapes double quotes, the HTML uses single quotes around data-name attribute. Attackers can bypass this by injecting payloads like \'><script>alert(1)</script>\' which breaks out of the attribute context and executes arbitrary JavaScript. The sanitization is incomplete.

evidence.note: User input flows from request.getParameter() through param/bar variables to response.getWriter().println() where unescaped single-quoted attributes allow XSS injection
